@MelRose92 Could you explain how you got the textures to work in Unreal?

@frandmckay Once you plug all the textures in, check on the material shader details: set the blend mode on masked, so it activates the opacity mask. Then from the base colour texture plug the "A" parameter of the RGBA in the opacity mask. For all the textures, I suggest to add a multiply node connected with a vector 1 parameter, so you can adjust the intensity. Also, make material instances so you can then adjust roughness intensity to 3 and metalness to 0, since the fur is way too glossy.
